# MenuForge

> Recipe costing and ingredient tracking for independent restaurants and breweries.

MenuForge helps chef-owners and kitchen managers know food costs down to the penny. Email or upload vendor invoices; pack costs update and every recipe recosts. Document recipes so the next hire can execute without a binder.

- URL: https://menuforge.ai
- App: https://app.menuforge.ai
- Pricing: https://menuforge.ai/pricing.html
- About: https://menuforge.ai/about.html
- Integrations: https://menuforge.ai/integrations.html
- MenuForge vs meez: https://menuforge.ai/vs/meez.html
- MenuForge vs MarketMan: https://menuforge.ai/vs/marketman.html
- Best recipe costing software for independent restaurants: https://menuforge.ai/best-recipe-costing-software-for-independent-restaurants.html

## Pricing (USD, monthly)

- Free: $0 — 1 user, 5 recipes
- Essentials: $79.95 — 3 users, 300 recipes
- AI+: $139.95 — 6 users, 300 recipes, 25 AI recipes/month, receipt processing, social posting
- Unlimited: $189.95 — unlimited users, recipes, and AI recipes
- Annual billing: 10% off
- Recipe storage add-ons: +500 recipes $20/mo, +1,000 recipes $50/mo
- AI credit packs (one-time): 5 for $20, 10 for $35
- Free plan: no credit card required

## What it does

- Live plate cost, minimum sell price, and contribution margin on the open recipe
- Sub-recipe / batch roll-up (sauces and vinaigrettes carry into parent dishes)
- Pantry with vendor variants (GFS and Sysco packs on the same ingredient)
- Receipt / invoice email-in or upload; price-change alerts
- Dietary flags that roll up from ingredients
- AI recipe generation with Cost Target, Pantry Usage, and Insanity sliders
- AI menu descriptions and unit conversions
- Post a dish to social media from the recipe card
- Toast POS: menu sync, recipe match, sales (see integrations)

## Who it is for

Independent restaurants, breweries, and food businesses. Built by Jake Lohse after a walkout at Presidential Brewing Company in Portage, Michigan left every recipe only in one cook's head.

## Who it is not for

Not a home-cook recipe app. Not an enterprise inventory suite with a six-month implementation.
